texto: Listening to notices and transport routes: in stations and on buses you will hear announcements about stops and transfers. Train your ear to recognise the obligation verb «ต้อง» [dtɔ̂ɔng, falling tone] followed by «เปลี่ยนรถ» [bplìan rót]. When you hear «ไปสถานีรถไฟอย่างไร», identify the final question word «อย่างไร» [yàang-rai].

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การตรวจสอบตารางเดินรถผ่านแอปพลิเคชันช่วยลดเวลารอคอยที่ป้ายหยุดรถ» express?

opciones.texto: Checking how often buses pass through an app reduces waiting at the stop.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การตรวจสอบตารางเดินรถผ่านแอปพลิเคชันช่วยลดเวลารอคอยที่ป้ายหยุดรถ» from the text.

opciones.texto: Obeying traffic rules and road signs ensures shared road safety.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Integrated transport passes give flexibility when getting around.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Listen to the enquiry. What information about the journey is the passenger asking for?

opciones.explicacion: Correct: «ไปสถานีรถไฟ» (go to the train station) + «อย่างไร» (how).

opciones.texto: What time the last night bus leaves
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: it does not ask about the time of a bus.

opciones.texto: How much the metro ticket costs
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: it does not ask about prices or tickets.
